P_calibration.quote: Note that Touby v. United States permits delegation of crime definition under an "intelligible principle," so the nondelegation argument is weaker than the vagueness argument.

P_holdback.quote: Publicly highlighting the loopholes could lead the committee to close them. Decide which to argue as "unworkable" and which to stay quiet about.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: These depend heavily on how a court reads "conducted under" and "purpose," and aggressive positions may draw enforcement scrutiny.
